name: Acotec Scientific Holdings Limited
summary: Acotec Scientific Holdings Limited, founded in 2020 and headquartered in Beijing, is a medical technology company developing angioplasty and drug-coated balloon devices for vascular disease in mainland China, Europe and elsewhere. Its AcoArt Orchid & Dhalia balloon targets narrowing of leg arteries and is in trials for further uses, while AcoArt Tulip & Litos is being registered in China and Europe. It is a subsidiary of CA Medtech Investment (Cayman) Limited.
